display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Returns ↔ Refund Reconciliation
formula_sql:
SELECT
  o.invoice_number,
  o.current_order_state,
  o.charged_amount AS return_order_value,
  s.settled_amount AS refund_settled,
  CASE WHEN s.invoice_number IS NULL THEN 'Missing in Settlement' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND s.transaction_type = 'reverse'
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.transaction_type = 'reverse';
